content:
Carmen: Heads-up — adding an accessibility + localization lane to the webinar runbook. Need: translated prompts, SRT captions, live-translate fallback, regional rehearsal windows. Deadline: Tue EOD.
Jules: Good call. For each demo ask speakers to provide: prompts.txt with EN + one translated language (lang code), srt/vtt captions for the 90s demo, 30s spoken script for interpreters, and recorded region-specific mp4 if available.
Hiro: For non-English prompts do we expect the same success criteria across locales?
Carmen: Yes — include a 1-line "success" note per language. e.g. "JP success: concise 3 bullets, culturally neutral examples".
Nina: OpsBot — can you create rehearsal slots across APAC/EU/US and tag sessions with region labels?
OpsBot: Will do. Post preferred 2-hour windows per speaker and I will create Zoom links, enable live CC, and attach caption files. I will also add a field in the event for "preferred language".
Jules: LegalBot — any compliance flags for showing Private deployment demos in non-EN regions?
LegalBot: Check data residency and customer IP disclosures in recorded clips. Avoid using real customer prompts in public assets; use synthetic or redacted examples. Include release_form.txt in every asset zip.
Hiro: Fallback plan: if live translation latency > 700ms or captions fail, switch to pre-recorded localized mp4 and load the SRT/VTT. OpsBot will flip source and note fallback_used in the tracker.
Carmen: Accessibility checklist to add to the runbook: auto captions ON, SRT uploaded to the event, slides include alt text, 1-line transcript per demo, and live-sign language option if requested.
Nina: Routing note: attendees who select a non-English language at registration -> route to regional SDR queue. Tag attendees by language and by "requested localized assets".
Carmen: Metrics to track by region: subtitle accuracy target 95%, localized opt-in rate (target 20%), recorded-fallback occurrences, registrant->attendee %, and post-webinar localized asset requests.
Jules: I'll drop a sample JP prompt + translated SRT and a 90s localized mp4 by Tue EOD. Tagging OpsBot for Asia rehearsal windows. :earth_asia:
